authority: User: continue with all specialist roles; selected Campaign combat and balance.
goal: An ammunition economy that rewards weapon choice and exploration without requiring secret supplies or repeatedly farming chapters.
constraints: Nine levels and approved chapter order unchanged.
Preserve original art, six weapon stats, creature health, dry audio and praised music unless a measured bug demands a bounded fix.
No adaptive spawning/HP, reloads, jumps, dashes, health bars or mandatory secrets.
Use all eight currently listed specialists in batches of at most3; root owns research/design/integration/provenance/Git.
Full original-concept visual fidelity and human pacing/listening approval are separate open gates.
policy_scope: Campaign only; old standalone/calibration behavior preserved. Ordinary full-ammo pickups remain available. Full bait contact still triggers the arena. Grants and pickup feedback report actual accepted ammunition.
validation: Normal starting health/armor/ammo, all9 real Main routes, physical E exits, carry/retry, no secrets/teleports/reseeding.
A second heavy-weapon route with actual shots/kills for all3 heavy guns.
Caps and actual pickup acceptance at saturation/partial values, no silent full-bait softlocks.
Moving-door/lift and geometry support regression where touched; native30/60/120 weapon/collision ownership.
Genuine exported game outside project and independent source/archive audit; actual stereo capture.

coordinator_reference_research.observations: Published original interaction implementation caps ammo, refuses already-full ordinary pickups, and distinguishes new weapon ownership from accepted ammo. Our exact capacity and budgets are original design choices; no source or assets copied.
coordinator_reference_research.relevance: Campaign saturation/partial pickup behavior and duplicate weapon grants.

coordinator_reference_research.observations: Original damage handler uses species pain probability; our existing guaranteed interruption differs. Preserve current promised hurt/cancellation behavior for this budget pass; matchup evidence reports its consequences.
coordinator_reference_research.relevance: Do not silently make hurt enemies release a cancelled attack.

weapon_role_direction.pistol: Precise finite fallback; stable20 damage/.32s, guaranteed hurt interruption retained.
weapon_role_direction.twin_shotgun: Two-shell close burst; wider spread, not a universal efficiency upgrade.
weapon_role_direction.rivet_cannon: Fast centered36damage suppression/precision; no invented armor penetration multiplier.
weapon_role_direction.siege_launcher: Crowd blast with real wall occlusion and self-risk; bot tests must consider nearby cover and clusters.

unchanged_values: All weapon damage/cadence/geometry, creature health/pain interruption, dry cues/music, original PNGs, stage graph/doors/lifts. Health/armor original pickup positions and totals must remain exact; only ammunition cases move on approach.

accepted_budget_iteration.reason: Both completed-profile source tests exhausted ammo late despite safe ordnance and actual use of owned guns. Add human aiming/overkill headroom while capacity still prevents chapter stockpiling. No secret or optional-room supplies used to establish route acceptance.
accepted_budget_iteration.included_in_totals: All arena bait grants; Ward first-gun grants; guaranteed normal supply cases. Optional/secret rewards excluded.
